_notes: Tobit 13 versification: The Vulgate/breviary uses a versification that differs from 思高. 思高 ch.13 has 17 verses but their content distribution differs. Verse mappings are approximate, based on content correspondence. 思高 Tob 13:2 reads '永生的天主应受赞颂，他的王权永远常存，因为他惩罚而又怜悯，把人抛在阴府的深处，而又把他从凄惨的祸患中救出，没有谁能逃出他的掌握。' — the breviary splits this into vv.1 and 2. For Tob 13:11 Jerusalem verse, 思高 13:10-11 content is used. Dan 3:52-57: 思高 numbers these as 52-57 consistent with Vulgate. 思高 Dan 3:52 says '上主，我们祖先的天主，你是可赞美的，应受称赞，应受颂扬，直到永远！你光荣的圣名，是可赞美的，应极受称赞，极受颂扬，直到永远。' — this is split across Vulgate vv. 52a and 52b+53 in breviary, but the breviary treats them as 52 (one verse) and 53 (name verse). The translations follow breviary verse divisions and place * mediant to divide the sense-units naturally. Lam 5:20-21: 思高 wording used verbatim; 5:20 'derelínques' rendered as '抛弃' following 思高 '抛弃'. The heading 'Canticum Tobiæ' is rendered as '托彼特赞歌' (Tobit's canticle); 'Canticum Trium Puerorum' as '三童赞歌' (Canticle of the Three Young Men).
